Retorno de Vapor

A pipeline or hose system connecting ship and shore to return displaced cargo vapours to the terminal during loading.

Questions and answers

What is Retorno de Vapor?

In this glossary, Retorno de Vapor refers to: A pipeline or hose system connecting ship and shore to return displaced cargo vapours to the terminal during loading.

How is Retorno de Vapor used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Certifique-se de que a mangueira de retorno de vapor está conectada e testada para vazamentos antes de iniciar operações de carregamento fechado."

Retorno de Vapor matters because it supports clear communication in Cargo contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.
